audit_metadata.title: Phase 2 — Multi-Source Geophysical & Geological Data Audit for Iron Ore Prospectivity
audit_metadata.study_region: Singhbhum-North Odisha Iron Ore Craton (Noamundi-Joda-Kiriburu-Gua-Bolani Belt)

data_sources_audit.agency: Geological Survey of India (GSI) / National Geoscience Data Repository (NGDR)
data_sources_audit.dataset_name: National Aero-geophysical Mapping Program (NAGMP) — High-Resolution Aeromagnetic Survey (HRAS)

survey_parameters.sensor: Cesium Vapor Magnetometer (sampling rate 10 Hz, sensitivity 0.001 nT)

derived_products: Total Magnetic Intensity (TMI) Grid (50m cell size, nT)
Reduced to Magnetic Pole (RTP) Grid (50m cell size, nT)
data_sources_audit.licensing: Government Open Data License - India (GODL) with Mandatory End-User Registration
data_sources_audit.blocker_details: GSI NGDR / Bhukosh portals require registered Indian citizen credentials, Aadhaar/corporate PAN verification, cart selection, and offline institutional email dispatch for GIS raster grid formats (Geosoft .grd / GeoTIFF). No unauthenticated programmatic REST API exists for direct raster downloads. In accordance with strict scientific integrity rules, synthetic or estimated magnetic values are rejected.
data_sources_audit.acquisition_plan: Submit formal institutional data request via NGDR portal for Quadrangle 73F aeromagnetic tensor grids.

vector_layers: Lithological Formations (Banded Hematite Jasper Member, Upper Shales, Lower Volcanics, Singhbhum Granite)
Structural Lineaments (Faults, Shear Zones, Synclinal Axes)
data_sources_audit.blocker_details: Bhukosh offers open WMS viewing in browser, but machine-readable vector GIS downloads (.shp/.geojson) require verified institutional login and cart checkout. WMS tile scraping is uncalibrated and forbidden under data integrity rules.
data_sources_audit.acquisition_plan: Download verified vector shapefiles through official authenticated GSI Bhukosh account.

data_sources_audit.agency: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) / NCEI
data_sources_audit.dataset_name: Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid (2-arc-minute resolution) — EMAG2v3
data_sources_audit.scientific_critique: While EMAG2v3 is openly downloadable, its native spatial resolution of ~3.7 km is two orders of magnitude too coarse to resolve individual Banded Iron Formation ridges (typically 100 m to 800 m wide) or open-cast hematite mine pits. Resampling a 3.7 km grid to 20 m produces fictitious spatial smoothness with zero exploration utility.

derived_terrain_features: Topographic Position Index (TPI) — identifying prominent ridge crests (>800m ASL) where resistant BHJ caps occur

magnetite_vs_hematite_paradox.summary: Primary BIF proto-ore is strongly magnetic, but high-grade supergene hematite is weakly magnetic.
mineralogical_physics: Primary Banded Magnetite Quartzite (BMQ) and unaltered Banded Hematite Jasper (BHJ) contain ferromagnetic magnetite (Fe3O4) with high magnetic susceptibility (k = 0.1 to 1.0 SI).
Supergene tropical enrichment leaches silica (quartz/chert) and oxidizes magnetite to martite/hematite (alpha-Fe2O3) and goethite (FeOOH).
Hematite is canted antiferromagnetic with very low magnetic susceptibility (k = 10^-4 to 10^-3 SI) — three orders of magnitude lower than magnetite.

CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC IMPLICATION: High-grade enriched hematite ore bodies (>62% Fe) often sit within or directly adjacent to magnetic lows relative to unweathered proto-ore BIF ridges. A naive machine-learning model trained on magnetic highs will prioritize low-grade unweathered magnetite-silica proto-ore and miss supergene high-grade hematite deposits.

newer_dolerite_false_positives.summary: Proterozoic dolerite dykes produce intense false magnetic anomaly lineaments.
newer_dolerite_false_positives.details: The Singhbhum Craton is extensively cross-cut by the Newer Dolerite Dyke Swarm (NNE-SSW and NW-SE trending tholeiitic dolerites/gabbros). These mafic rocks contain abundant titanomagnetite and produce strong linear aeromagnetic anomalies (TMI highs > 500 nT) that do not correlate with iron ore mineralization. Without mapped geological dyke masks, aeromagnetic data alone will yield massive false-positive classifications.

deposit_boundary_accuracy.summary: Nominal point coordinates do not capture non-linear deposit morphology.
deposit_boundary_accuracy.details: The 5 curated mines (Noamundi, Joda East, Kiriburu, Gua, Bolani) are non-linear, structurally folded hematite ridges spanning 2 km to 8 km in strike length and 200 m to 1,200 m in width. Using circular buffer radii around nominal pit centroids introduces mixed boundary pixels containing country rock shales, haulage roads, and overburden dumps. Authoritative digitized mining lease polygon vectors (from IBM / State DGM) are required before sub-deposit spatial training can be defensibly executed.

feature_groups.group_name: Group A: Optical Remote Sensing (Sentinel-2 L2A)
Group D: Geological Lithology & Structure (GSI Bhukosh)
feature_groups.rasterization_method: Rasterized at 20 m with exact polygon boundary clipping
features: dist_to_synclinal_axis_m (continuous distance to regional fold hinge)

baseline_comparison_architecture.evaluation_methodology: Strict Spatially Blocked Leave-One-Deposit-Out Cross-Validation (5 Folds: Noamundi, Joda East, Kiriburu, Gua, Bolani)

planned_model_comparisons.limitation: Fails across unseen deposits due to laterite/regolith spectral confounding.

planned_model_comparisons.expected_effect: Filters out low-lying alluvium, but cannot differentiate BHJ ridge crests from unmineralized granite hills.
Provides structural BIF detection, but requires dolerite dyke discrimination.

planned_model_comparisons.features: Group A + Group B + Group C + Group D (19 features)
planned_model_comparisons.expected_effect: Highest theoretical prospectivity skill; constrains spectral anomalies to verified BHJ horizons and magnetic structural keels.

scientific_verdict.rationale: High-resolution aeromagnetic grids and 1:50,000 vector lithological shapefiles are currently held behind Indian government portal authentication (GSI NGDR / Bhukosh) and are not accessible via unauthenticated REST endpoints. Without these real datasets, training a multi-source model would require fabricating synthetic geophysical rasters, directly violating scientific integrity. The system correctly maintains Iron Ore AI prospectivity scores as UNAVAILABLE while serving authentic Sentinel-2 surface spectral ratios and published GSI/IBM geological descriptions.
